goal: Add regression tests locking fail-closed documents-only classification for .py and other non-prose files on both classifiers (classifyChangedPaths and classifyLightweightMergePullRequestFiles) plus the merge-authorization adapter. No production code change.
dispatcher: MiMo chat parent dispatch for issue #3488
prohibited_actions: Do not change any production classifier or workflow logic; this PR is tests-only.
Do not weaken or delete any existing test assertion.
Do not touch any migration, database object, or live row.
assumptions: The existing classifiers are already fail-closed for non-prose paths; these tests lock that property in.
CI Agent work contract requires an evidence pair because test files count as code.
stop_conditions: Stop if any existing test assertion must be weakened to make the new tests pass.
Stop on any gate refusal rather than weakening the gate.
Stop if the change needs a file outside allowed_paths.
